systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS), Namwala District
systems.owner: Akros, in partnership with the Ministry of General Education, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: one district (Namwala), from 2016; data entered on tablets as one monthly and one termly report; scaling to more districts and national reports are stated as hopes
schools report yearly on paper; entered into the ministry's database; enrolment only

note: No emis fact: the document says the Namwala system captures aggregate data monthly (enrolment and attendance counts of teachers and students, WASH, literacy and numeracy exam scores, feeding days), not a record per learner. It is entered during the year, so it is not a census either; single-function is the nearest class (aggregate totals sent up) and the parent should check it. The page is undated (footer 2021-06-14; row year 2025) and describes a programme begun in 2016.
